meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Vacation rental and short-term rental property management software (channel manager, PMS, direct booking)

analysis.summary: Hostaway publishes the widest mix: news explainers, research, case studies. Rivals stay narrower: Lodgify refreshes sales pages, Hospitable pushes money and tax tools, OwnerRez posts customer news, Uplisting adds feature pages.

points.text: Hostaway is the only one reacting fast to platform changes, with Vrbo's 12% fee, Booking.com phone numbers and Airbnb's fall update all new.
Lodgify updated 13 older pages, mostly channel manager and Airbnb/Booking.com software pages. This looks like a refresh of its buying pages.
Hospitable is building around money tasks: payments, taxes and trust accounting, across 4 of its 6 new pages.

Hostaway.play: Fast explainers on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com changes, plus case studies and an AI benchmark report

Hospitable.play: Pushes payments, tax and trust accounting tools, plus a rent-type calculator

OwnerRez.play: Announces integrations, podcast episodes and a customer profile for existing users

Lodgify.play: Refreshes channel manager and Airbnb/Booking.com software pages, plus a free host summit

Uplisting.play: Launches three feature pages: tasks, compliance, and deposits and disputes

shared.title: Task management pages
shared.text: Lodgify and Uplisting both focus on task management for rentals. Hostaway has no page on this in its recent data, so check coverage.

shared.title: Money and compliance features
shared.text: Hospitable (payments, taxes), Lodgify (payment processing) and Uplisting (compliance, deposits) all publish pages on handling money and rules. Hostaway's new pages in this area are thin.

shared.title: Localbird tie-ins
shared.text: OwnerRez announced a Localbird integration and Hospitable ran a Localbird podcast. Both are courting the same partner's audience.

gaps.title: STR trust accounting guides
gaps.text: Only Hospitable covers it, including Australia. Hostaway could publish trust accounting guides for several countries.

gaps.title: Tax and compliance explainers
gaps.text: Hospitable and Uplisting publish product pages only. Hostaway could own plain-English how-to guides on tax and rules.

gaps.title: Channel manager comparison hubs
gaps.text: Lodgify owns single-channel pages. Hostaway could publish neutral side-by-side guides to win evaluators; it has just 1 comparison page.
